printings.flavor: Light up, flame out, and burn it all down.
Whatever it takes for us to survive.
“I’ll use what I have to get what I want.”

“99% of everything is trash. That’s why I pay someone else to search it for me.”
—Sturg3on_General
The volume is the message.

“I’m on retainer for monthly purges on thirty-six different servers.”
—Ratu Maharani, pawang virus
The waters begin to roil, and bit by bit they swell.

“Nil SIR, black noise, lost girls, drowned boys!”
—Ryō “Phoenix” Ōno
“In the end, they raised the rent and we were out on the street. But the riots had tanked property values so much we moved back in—with a better deal!”
Try me.
Peer pressure works.

“…one-hundred and twenty-seven rounds fired, and two police hoppers totaled. Miraculously, no officers were hurt, though the suspect remains at large.”
—Abdul el-Sattar, KKN 6
“Pity the money’s being spent here, when I could be buying hiasan for my apartment.”

“Don’t let self-respect get in the way of a good shortcut.”
—“G0ph3r” OʼRyan

“In KK, we say ‘harimau mati karena belangnya’. It means don't tell the world how much money you have if you plan on keeping it.”
—JokoR

“You think I’ve finished messing with you?
Yeah, nah.”
—Barry “Baz” Wong
Consequences only matter if they catch you.

“She’s learned from the best: me. When I retire, the KK Tri-Maf’ll be in good hands.”
—Barry “Baz” Wong

“That kepo NBN gang makes trillions off incidental data scraping. So what if I use it to network?”
—MuslihaT

Who else will teach the stories of good and evil?
We can’t leave the corps’ dirty deeds in the shadows.
Good design is invisible—but I’ll never settle for ‘good’.
“Won’t she get in trouble for putting that in the show? And how did she even find out?!”
Every day starts the same: tea, news, a threedee puzzle. Then it’s off to work. Magdalene won’t let being fired get in the way of completing her masterpiece.

“For my children’s sake, I’ll endure any pain.”
—Dewi Subrotoputri, as Dyah Kunthi

“The Net operates almost as much on dream logic as it does digital logic. If you believe something to be true, it often is.”
—The Encyclopedia Silica

“I still have friends on the inside.”
—Magdalene Keino-Chemutai
On the shoulders of giants.

There are a hundred currencies in the undercity, and Knickknack takes them all. Creds and rupiah get you noodles. For his secret menu, he’ll take your burnt-out rigs, your sterilized virii. But to taste his smoked vatchicken stew, bring him what he values most: your story.

“They were fast, friendly, and efficient. ★★★★☆.”
—satisfied customer
Workers of the World, Delivered.
Fashion fades. Poétrï is eternal.
“Don’t tell me you were at the gala, darling? I must not have seen you!”
“Deploying in T-minus 5…”
“Don’t be scared of the Ottos, kiddo. They’re building our future!”
“You dare?”

“It is a fallacy that conscious observation can change reality. The consciousness of the observer isn’t required at all.”
—The Encyclopedia Silica

“I am a very reasonable manager. I do not expect my staff to do anything I could not do.”
—Bass CH1R180G4

“The instability of human braintapes is directly proportional to the number of limbs on a given bioroid, so we’ve begun phasing them out for something better-equipped. A human braintape could be working beside an octopus for weeks and never have an inkling.”
—Maía Mínervudóttir, R&D
“My predecessor had passion, imagination, ambition. I assure you, I possess no such flaws.”
The Looming Future.
We rely too much on spatial cognition. What happens when that system receives a null signal?
You thought you were safe?
“I make the best company.”
Jinteki’s most experimental ice are often their most dangerous.
The silence of the forest is the surest sign of danger.
Peer reviews are the difference between living in the arcs and living in the slums. Cloneline gengineering never made anything as vicious or cutthroat as a Jinteki scientist.
Spring-loaded minds, kept in suspension to be launched into the net at any incursion.

Igniting your potential.
Never stop shining.
Every Impulse Monitored.
That’s so fifteen minutes ago.
You don’t really want to know what makes you unique as a person. It’s so much less than you think.

“Give me five minutes of a user’s Access Plaza traffic and I’ll tell you where they’re having lunch tomorrow. Give me another ten, and I’ll have their bibi’s secret rendang recipe.”
—Luzviminda Reyes, Synapse Sales

They know what makes you tick.
And ticked-off.

”On the Net, we hold the power.”
 —Arnold Teoh, NBN technologist
“I believe you have something of ours.”
“Your Star Power is in the toilet, kid. We need a fresh face.”
We’ll be there.
Action at a distance.
“It’s been a real pleasure doing business with you.”

“If you lived here, you’d be at work by now!”
—Weyland recruiter
“Rejoice, executives! The Net has sent unto us a profit!”

“Dammit, Moth! Where are you? This thing is way bigger than you s—”
—C0nr4d

“The detritus of failed incursions accumulates. Instead of sweeping it all away, the parsimonious sysop should nudge this debris into defensive positions in the server’s metagravity well.”
—Moira Virtue, Ice Engineering, KKU
Designed by 2023 World Champion William “Sokka” Huang

“We would like to reassure our shareholders that none of the buildings damaged in the blast were owned by Weyland Consortium subsidiaries…”
—Luana Campos, Weyland spokesperson
Stop that.
Itur in antiquam telam.
